title: Tonight, the Moon moves twice as close

scenes.text: Tonight, the Moon moves twice as close.
It would look twice as wide in the sky.
Tidal forces would jump about eightfold.
Oceans would surge far up every coastline.
Coastal cities could flood almost every day.
Even the month would shrink to about ten days.
But here is the twist. The real Moon is drifting away.
About four centimeters farther every year.
So nothing like this is coming.
But that is exactly what would happen if
